senses.gloss: to stir up, gather in a crowd.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 10</cite> <he>שהוא עתיד להַרְגִּישׁ וכ׳</he> he shall stir up all nations and bring them to Jerusalem; a. e.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 14">Ex. R. s. 14</cite> <he>היו נוטלין … ולא היינו מַרְגִּישִׁין</he> they might have taken all our belongings in the days of darkness, and we should not have noticed it.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:1-8">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>הביא</he> … <he>ולא ה׳ פרעה</he> God brought plagues upon the Egyptians, but Pharaoh did not care; <he>כיון … התחיל מַרְגִּישׁ וכ׳</he> when the plague touched his own body, he began to feel it and cry &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 15b:14">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>אולי יַרְגִּישׁ המקום וכ׳</he> (Esther, in inviting Haman, thought,) perhaps God will feel (compassion at my self-humiliation), and do a miracle for us.

<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:7">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אין בשר המת מרגיש באיזמל</he> dead flesh feels not the knife (we have grown indolent through the frequency of persecutions); <he>אין … שבחי מרגיש וכ׳</he> the dead flesh in a living body feels not &c.; Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ bot. Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ bot. <he>לא הִרְגַּשְׁתָּ</he> didst thou not feel (the lizard’s bite)? <he>יבא עלי … אם הִרְגַּשְׁתִּי</he> may evil befall me, if, in my devotion …, I felt it. Y. Erub. I, 19ᵇ <he>שאילו ישמט הוא מרגיש</he> if it should slip off, he would find it out.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47">Gen. R. s. 47</cite> <he>ה׳ ונצטער</he> he felt (the pain of circumcision) and suffered.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>כל הפירות … מַרְגִּישִׁים … וכילם … ומרגישים</he> of all fruits in a bag, you take some, and the others are not affected, but in the case of nuts … all are in heavy commotion; <he>כך ישראל … וכילם מרגישים</he> so is it with Israel: one man sins, and all feel the effect of it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992:10">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:11">Lam. R. to II, 7</cite> <he>קול צרות מְרַגְּשׁוֹת</he> the noise of exciting troubles.

senses.gloss: to come in crowds, rush forth, storm. Tanḥ. Lekh 9 עתידין … להִתְרַגֵּשׁ עליהם all kings shall come in a rage against them. Y. Ber. V, 8ᵈ bot. those hard times (v. חָצַף) היוצאות המִתְרַגְּשׁות לבא לעולם which go forth, which rush to enter the world.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 80b:11">B. Kam. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ושאר פורעניות המתרגשות ובאות וכ׳</he> and other calamities which break forth and visit a community; <cite ref="Taanit 14a">Taan. 14ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
